title: GTA 6 Release Week Clears the PS5 Schedule
description: GTA 6 is finally coming out this week on PS5, and according to Push Square, its massive launch has sent nearly every other game running for the hills.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Release Week Clears the PS5 Schedule

When a true industry juggernaut prepares to launch, the entire gaming calendar shifts to accommodate it. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, this week (16th-22nd November) has been heavily shaped by a single, monumental release: **GTA 6**.

### A Juggernaut That Clears the Room

Very few titles in gaming history possess the gravity to force competing publishers to completely alter their schedules. Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece is launching on PS5 at long last, and its presence has sent nearly every other game running for the hills, as Push Square bluntly pointed out in their recent coverage.

Industry analysis suggests that developers and publishers are well aware of the oxygen-depleting effect such a colossal release has on the market. Trying to launch a major title in the exact same window as GTA 6 is widely viewed as commercial suicide, leading to a remarkably quiet alternative release slate for the week.

### What This Means for PS5 Owners

For PlayStation 5 players, the choice this week is abundantly clear. The gaming conversation, media attention, and community focus are locked squarely onto Rockstar's latest open-world epic. While a handful of other titles may still technically squeeze into the release windows, they are undeniably playing in the absolute shadow of a giant.

### Editor's Take

Push Square's candid coverage captures the sheer, undeniable magnitude of GTA 6's arrival. When a single video game can practically empty out a release week because competitors are too terrified to share the spotlight, you know you are witnessing a defining moment for the PS5 generation.
